title: E is for Extinction #1 Marvel 2015 Secret Wars Battleworld X-Men Chris Burnham
condition_description: Bright, clean covers with light handling wear. See photos.
description:
E is for Extinction #1 (August 2015), Marvel Comics - Secret Wars Battleworld tie-in revisiting Grant Morrison's New X-Men era. Written by Chris Burnham, art by Ramon Villalobos, colors by Ian Herring. Direct edition, $4.99 cover price.

Back cover: Harley-Davidson ad.

Condition: bright, clean covers with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
